## What it checks (sampled describe/it titles)

- KMedoidsAlgorithm.cluster — happy paths
- HAPPY: 2 well-separated clusters → 2 labels, medoids match cluster ids
- HAPPY: k=1 reduces to single best-medoid (center of uniform line is index 2)
- HAPPY: k=n → every point its own medoid → cost=0
- HAPPY: ROBUSTNESS TO OUTLIER — one medoid is in dense cluster (0..3), one is the outlier (4)
- HAPPY: 3-D points cluster correctly
